# GNU Emacs 31.1 `etc` resources

This directory contains a selected set of 605 resource files copied
byte-for-byte from the installed GNU Emacs 31.1 tree at
`/usr/local/share/emacs/31.1/etc/`. Per-file source paths and SHA-256
digests are recorded in `vendor/ORIGIN` and `vendor/SHA256SUMS`.

This README is repository-authored documentation, not an upstream GNU
Emacs file. The upstream resources retain their own notices and license
terms. Consult `COPYING`, `images/README`, and the relevant subdirectory
README files for GNU and third-party attribution and licensing details;
the image collection does not have a single uniform license.
